headline: Lite-On Reports Record Q3 Profit Driven by Surging Demand for AI Hardware
summary: Lite-On Technology posted record profit and expanding operating margins for Q3 2026, supported by robust demand for artificial intelligence server components.
why: Lite-On Technology is a Taiwanese supplier of power management, electronics, and optoelectronics components used in cloud and AI datacenters.
